attempts.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: isolated transparent far-architecture layer for an offline Nuke desert live-action composite.
Primary request: A distant eroded sandstone astronomical ruin: one huge broken circular observatory ring and exactly three low stepped terraces, monumental but restrained.
Input image: The supplied live-action desert plate is a lighting, camera and color reference only. Do not composite into the plate and do not recreate its mountains or ground.
Style/medium: Photoreal architectural visual effects matte element, convincing weathered warm beige stone with erosion and fine chipped edges. Long-lens near-level view, nearly frontal, little perspective convergence.
Composition/framing: One wide 16:9 image. The whole complete ruin silhouette and its base are visible in the lower half with transparent margins on all sides. Keep architectural forms legible at a distance.
Lighting/mood: Match the reference's front/camera-left high warm sunlight, cool dusty shadows, pale dusty atmospheric desaturation. No dramatic sunset or neon.
Constraints: Genuine alpha transparency everywhere outside the ruin. No desert ground, no sky, no background or mountains behind the object. This is a separate distant architectural insert, not a final composited scene. Do not include a sword.
Avoid: people, writing, glyphs, captions, text, logos, brands, UI, watermark, collage, contact sheet, fake checkerboard.
